jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning financial insight into commercial impact? Join Deloitte’s Nordic Sales Excellence Team to develop compelling pricing strategies and commercial solutions that deliver value for clients and strengthen profitability. This is an exciting opportunity to help increase the win rate and shape commercial decisions for Deloitte’s largest and most important deals.

About us

With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

Join our diverse Nordic Technology & Transformation Sales Excellence team and help shape Deloitte’s most strategic pursuits. The team helps win deals and improve profitability through compelling pricing and commercial propositions for our clients. We provide expert advice on all commercial aspects of client proposals, focusing primarily on higher-value, more complex deals and Deloitte’s most important Nordic clients.

This role can be placed either in Copenhagen, Denmark or in Oslo, Norway.

What will be your role?

We aim to become the largest professional services firm in the Nordics by continuously innovating, evolving and adapting to meet clients’ needs. To achieve this, we need to strengthen our commercial expertise to support our most complex deals, to our most important clients. You will play a key role in our Nordic Sales Excellence team, and your worksite is therefore flexible within the Nordics.

As our Commercial and Pricing Specialist, your role will be to structure and shape commercial solutions to respond to our client’s requirements and challenges and to help win business and improve profitability. You will work closely with the rest of the Nordic Sales Excellence Team and the stakeholders for our major Nordic accounts to shape commercial arrangements.

The core responsibilities of your role include:

• Shape commercial solutions for complex opportunities, bringing together clients’ needs, pricing options and commercial considerations into compelling proposals

• Develop pricing strategies and structures that demonstrate value to clients and improve our ability to win work

• Build and challenge deal economics through financial modelling, testing margins, assumptions, pricing scenarios and commercial risks

• Partner with proposal teams to design and implement commercial strategies that grow revenue and strengthen profitability

• Advance value-based pricing by helping pursuit teams identify and quantify expected clients’ outcomes, then translate them into appropriate pricing models

• Support proposals and negotiations by clearly articulating the pricing structure and commercial assumptions, and advising on terms and trade-offs

• Build commercial capability across the Nordics through practical guidance, training, knowledge sharing and improvements to the various tools and ways of working

Who are we looking for?

You are a commercially minded professional with strong analytical and modelling skills, together with good business acumen. We are looking for a team player with a collegiate style who enjoys working, collaborating and having fun with team-mates.

We imagine that you have:

• A minimum of 5 years’ experience in pricing, commercial finance, deal shaping or a related commercial role; professional-services experience is an advantage

• A strong financial modelling and Excel skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations

• Experience with leveraging AI applications in commercial work, with the judgement to evaluate outputs

• Confidence working with senior stakeholders and collaborating across functions and countries

• Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain pricing choices and commercial terms

• It would be desirable, but not essential, to have professional services experience and insights, ideally having worked within a consulting or professional service organisation

• Flexibility to meet peaks of work inherent in the cycle of a deal

• Proficient in written and spoken English. Knowledge of another Scandinavian language is a benefit

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What impact will your role make?

Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration and high performance. We do not just aspire to make solutions. We wish to create an impact that makes a positive and crucial difference for the people around us, our clients and our society. Deloitte is where you’ll find unlimited opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.

Do you want to be a part of our team?

Please submit your CV and answer a few questions about your experience. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the position once the right candidate has been identified.

Application deadline is December 1, 2026.

Please do not hesitate to contact Inu Agarwal at inuagarwal@deloitte.no if you have any questions about the position.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Shape the future of Global Benefits Management across the Nordics – building on a strong client portfolio, accelerating growth, raising our market profile and developing the next generation of Nordic GBM talent.

The Role

Lead WTW’s Nordic Global Benefits Management business within Integrated & Global Solutions. This high-impact role combines market leadership, business development, client management and people leadership across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland. As a visible senior representative of WTW, you will build trusted relationships with executive decision-makers and help multinational organisations turn global benefits strategies into action.

This is a market-facing growth role. You will originate, shape and convert significant GBM opportunities across the Nordic region while protecting and expanding WTW’s existing client portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

• Shape the market – Be a recognised voice for GBM across the Nordics and strengthen WTW’s profile with multinational employers, external advisers and internal stakeholders.

• Accelerate growth – Build and convert a sustainable, multi-year Nordic pipeline, winning significant new GBM mandates and creating a stronger platform for long-term growth.

• Lead priority pursuits and client relationships – Shape compelling value propositions, navigate complex commercial discussions and help teams convert major opportunities into long-term mandates. Act as executive sponsor for selected priority clients, protecting renewals, expanding relationships and maintaining continuity from the sales process through implementation and ongoing delivery.

• Connect the best of WTW – Bring together capabilities and people from different parts of WTW to address complex client needs across the Nordics and beyond.

• Ensure excellent delivery – Provide oversight across client engagements, helping teams deliver against agreed objectives, quality standards, budgets and timelines.

• Grow our people – Coach and mentor Nordic GBM colleagues, strengthen commercial capability, support succession planning and develop future leaders.

About you

You are an established senior leader with deep knowledge of the Nordic market, a strong network and a proven record of delivering growth. Strategic and hands-on in equal measure, you build credibility quickly with C-suite executives, international benefits leaders and colleagues at every level.

Experience and capabilities

• 10+ years’ experience advising multinational organisations on global or regional employee benefits programmes and related consulting services.

• A strong record of winning complex engagements, meeting sales and utilisation goals, and building trusted relationships with senior decision-makers across the Nordic market.

• Demonstrated success managing major client relationships, leading cross-country teams and delivering multiple high-quality projects on time and within budget.

• A confident professional presence, with polished written and verbal communication skills.

• Sound judgement, strong problem-solving skills and the flexibility to diagnose issues and move them towards resolution.

• The ability to see the bigger picture, connect capabilities across practices and turn data into clear insights and practical solutions.

• A genuine commitment to coaching, training and mentoring colleagues.

• Confidence using Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint, together with AI-enabled tools.

• A bachelor’s degree.

• Willingness to travel across the Nordic region and internationally as required.

• International work or living experience and foreign-language skills are welcome but not essential.

What we offer

Join a collaborative international team with a strong client portfolio and significant room to grow. You will have the platform to shape WTW’s Nordic GBM strategy, build a high-performing regional business and make a visible contribution to our ambitions. We offer flexible working arrangements and a competitive total rewards package, including performance-related and locally relevant benefits.

About WTW and IGS

WTW combines data, insight and expertise to create solutions across people, risk and capital.

You will join WTW’s Integrated & Global Solutions (IGS) team and be based in the Copenhagen or Stockholm area, with flexibility around location.

IGS brings together more than 350 colleagues across WTW’s global network to address the headquarters needs of multinational clients. We help organisations navigate the business, cultural, linguistic and regulatory complexities of operating across markets.

Equal Opportunity Employer

WTW is committed to equal opportunity and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from qualified candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, perspectives and locations.

Combine hands-on software development with team leadership and make a real impact on cybersecurity and global security

Are you an experienced software engineer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges and helping other developers succeed? Do you want to combine hands-on development with team leadership and have a direct influence on the architecture and evolution of mission-critical products?

This is your opportunity to make a difference.

Our client, Arbit Cyber Defence Systems, is growing rapidly and is looking for a dedicated Software Development Team Lead to join its R&D department in Hvidovre, just outside Copenhagen.

In this key role, you will lead a team of software engineers while remaining close to the code, the architecture and the technology. You will take ownership of software releases, Linux systems and development processes, helping ensure that your team delivers robust, high-quality software that meets the highest standards of security and performance.

If you are ready to combine technical depth with people leadership and contribute to protecting critical networks and sensitive information across borders, this could be your next career move.

About Arbit Cyber Defence Systems

Arbit develops high-end network protection solutions for an international customer base, including intelligence agencies, armed forces and national governments. Its certified Cross Domain Solutions, including Data Diodes and TRUST Gateways, enable secure data transfer between networks operating at different security classification levels. With customers operating in some of the world’s most demanding security environments, Arbit plays an important role in protecting sensitive information and securing critical digital infrastructure across national borders.

Arbit’s R&D department brings together two development teams—Release and Project—alongside project management, hardware engineering and quality assurance specialists. You will join a highly skilled, collaborative environment where technical excellence, innovation and reliability are essential.

The role: Technical leadership with real influence

Reporting directly to the CTO, you will lead the Release development team, taking responsibility for its technical direction, delivery and people development. You will work closely with the CTO on technical decisions and development planning, helping translate product ambitions into robust, well-engineered solutions.

You will balance hands-on engineering with leadership, ensuring that your team has the direction, structure and support it needs to succeed.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership & Software Development

• Combine hands-on software development with responsibility for the architecture, design and continuous improvement of Arbit’s core products.

• Develop high-performance software components for unidirectional data transfer, with a strong focus on security, reliability and maintainability.

Release Management & Linux Systems

• Own software releases, ensuring efficient development processes, reliable CI/CD pipelines and delivery of high-quality software on time.

• Oversee Linux systems, make sure that a good infrastructure and hardware/software integration is built.

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, motivate and develop your team, creating a positive environment where people thrive, grow their skills and deliver their best work.

• Set priorities, drive progress and represent the team within the organisation.

Collaboration & Innovation

• Work closely with the CTO on technical decisions, architecture and development planning.

• Collaborate with Project Development, Quality Assurance, Service Delivery and Product Management to ensure thorough testing, smooth delivery and continued product innovation.

Your background

We are looking for an experienced software engineer with a strong systems mindset and a genuine interest in leading people.

You understand that a single line of code can affect the security, reliability and performance of an entire hardware/software system. You enjoy diving into technical details, but you also know how to create clarity, set direction and bring out the best in a team.

You may already be an experienced Team Lead looking for a role with substantial technical depth—or a senior engineer who is ready to take the next step into formal leadership.

What you bring

• Extensive software engineering experience: At least 10 years of professional software development experience, ideally including the development of a software product from the ground up through to production. Experience with Java and C++ is highly relevant.

• Leadership potential: Experience in team leadership and people management is an advantage. Alternatively, you may have mentored less experienced developers and be ready to take on your first formal leadership role.

• Strong systems understanding: A solid foundation in computer science, software architecture and system design, ideally complemented by knowledge of relevant standards and compliance requirements.

• Linux expertise: Practical experience with Linux system management and a good understanding of system integration, build environments and release infrastructure.

• A structured, proactive approach: You create momentum, establish clear priorities and take ownership of progress and results.

• A collaborative mindset: You communicate clearly, build strong working relationships and enjoy working across disciplines.

• Relevant education: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field.

• Language skills: Fluency in English is essential. If you are not fluent in Danish, you should have a good understanding of the language.

Security clearance: Due to the nature of Arbit’s customers and products, you must be eligible to obtain and maintain a SECRET (HEMMELIGT) security clearance.

Why join Arbit?

• Make a difference: Develop advanced cybersecurity solutions for international clients and help protect critical networks and sensitive information.

• Shape technology and people: Influence core product development while leading a skilled team of engineers in a collaborative R&D environment.

• Flexibility and benefits: Enjoy flexible working hours, the option to work from home, a pension scheme, healthcare, fitness facilities and team-building activities.

• A close-knit team: Join a growing company with more than 25 employees, an informal culture and a strong team spirit.

More about Arbit Cyber Defence Systems

Founded in 2006, Arbit has established itself as a specialist in advanced cybersecurity solutions for highly sensitive environments. As the need to protect critical networks and information continues to grow, Arbit’s technology plays an increasingly important role.

Arbit is among a small number of companies worldwide whose products have achieved NATO COSMIC TOP SECRET and EU TOP SECRET accreditation.

Learn more at arbitcds.com.

Are you interested in joining Arbit?

Please do not hesitate to apply for the position by sending your CV and a short application. If you have questions, you are most welcome to contact Director Sara Juhl at Bloom via sj@bloom.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insight they need to make better financial decisions. All connected directly to the Danish tax authority. We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.

Our platform has grown with us. The infrastructure that keeps Skatteguiden running has reached a scale and complexity that deserves full-time, specialist ownership, and the work ahead makes this an unusually good time to join.

About the role

You'll be joining the Platform team as a Platform Application Engineer, the counterpart to our Operational Platform team, which owns the infrastructure. Where they own the systems that keep Skatteguiden running, you'll own the shared application-layer services that the rest of engineering depends on.

The team treats these services as a product, with engineers distributed across several product teams as their users. Every product team touches payments, identity, and integrations. Your job is to make those services reliable, well-designed, and genuinely easy to build on, across a microservices architecture that favours low coupling and event-driven communication over direct dependencies.

We operate on a simple principle: you build it, you own it. That means end-to-end accountability, from design and implementation through to what happens when something goes wrong. Incidents aren't escalated to someone else's queue; they're yours to understand, resolve, and learn from.

What you'll do

Own the shared application platform. Design and build the core backend services underpinning payments, identity, authorisation, and third-party integrations — the shared foundation that product teams rely on every day.

Build and maintain payment services. Design payment flows that are reliable, observable, and compliant. Work with product teams to support new features and providers without coupling concerns or creating fragility in the critical path.

Own identity and authorisation. Design the systems that manage who our users are and what they can do — from OAuth flows and token management to fine-grained permission models and audit trails.

Integrate security and privacy into the application layer. Work with our Head of Security & Privacy to translate requirements into technical controls — particularly in identity, authorisation, and data handling — with GDPR and ISO 27001 in mind.

Integrate third-party systems. Own the integration layer connecting messaging, payment providers, and others. Ensure resilience, observability, and clear contracts.

Improve the developer experience. Build shared libraries, abstractions, and internal tooling that make it easier for product engineers to build on top of platform services correctly and confidently. Reduce the cognitive load on teams that shouldn't need to think about auth or payment internals.

Who we're looking for

You're likely a senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, and who sees that role not just as backend development but as a product discipline — with the engineers who depend on your services as your primary users.

You take end-to-end ownership seriously. You don't consider something done when the code is merged, you care about how it behaves in production, you're on the hook when it doesn't, and you treat incidents as feedback worth acting on.

You're genuinely collaborative, someone who makes the people around them better, shares context freely, and doesn't work in isolation. And you're curious: you like trying new things, you're not attached to the way things have always been done, and you get energy from learning.

Must-have

A senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, writes clean, maintainable services, takes API design seriously, and cares about the boundaries between components.

Hands-on experience deploying and debugging services on Kubernetes in production; you know how to get code running reliably in a Kubernetes environment without needing to own the cluster.

Experience designing MySQL schemas for production, migrations, indexing, query performance, and keeping data models clean as requirements evolve.

Working knowledge of message brokers such as RabbitMQ, event-driven patterns, consumer reliability, and how to design async communication that is easy to reason about across a distributed codebase.

Understanding of identity and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, RBAC), and how to implement them securely and maintainably at scale.

Security, privacy, and compliance awareness. You design with GDPR, auditability, and least-privilege access in mind from the start, not as an afterthought.

A platform as a product mindset. Experience thinking about developer experience as a product discipline, not just an engineering concern.

Genuine enthusiasm for AI. You use it daily, and you're always looking for new ways to apply it.

Nice-to-have

Experience building or operating payment integrations — familiarity with PSPs, webhook reliability, idempotency, and reconciliation.

Familiarity with React and TypeScript — enough to read, understand, and occasionally contribute to frontend code when the work calls for it.

Familiarity with Azure. You know your way around the platform — how services connect, how access and permissions work, and how to build in a cloud-native context.

Familiarity with our observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry.

Familiarity with our GitOps tooling: ArgoCD and GitHub Actions.

Why join us

A substantial project from day one. The hosting migration means designing a production system from scratch, rare at any company.

Real influence. The architectural decisions made in this team will shape how Skatteguiden is built and operated for years. It's a small team with a high degree of autonomy, and the work is genuinely consequential.

Strong engineering culture. We take the technical foundations seriously. Security, architecture, and technical debt get real attention, not just lip service.

The product matters. Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden. Your work keeps it running and makes it possible to grow.

Solid company. We're independent, profitable, and growing. No VC pressure, no bloated roadmap. Just a clear mission and a team that cares.

A company that's serious about AI. We use AI across the business and we're only going deeper. Being a small, focused team means we can move fast on this, no lengthy approval chains, no slow rollouts. If you're always looking for ways to work smarter with AI, you'll fit right in.

Good people. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. The culture is professional, informal, and genuinely collaborative.

Practical detailsLocation

Copenhagen. We're an office-first company, and it's a deliberate choice. We're moving fast, we have big ambitions, and we genuinely believe that being physically together is one of the things that makes that possible. Things move quicker when you can turn your chair and talk to someone. We want to be upfront about this so you know what to expect.

And if we're asking people to be in the office, we want it to be worth their while. We're a five-minute walk from Rådhuspladsen, stocked with everything from fruit to fizzy drinks to afternoon snacks, and lunch is at Claus Meyer's canteen just across the street, proper food, not an afterthought. If you're putting in a long day, dinner is covered too.

Start: As soon as possible

Salary: Competitive and based on your experience.

Reporting to: CTO

Screening call with our recruiter (30 min) ONLINE

Technical interview with the manager and an engineer (120 min) ONSITE

Meeting with our CEO (45 min) ONSITE

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

Veo’s web platform brings together some of our most important customer experiences. We are looking for a Staff Experience Designer with deep Web expertise to own design outcomes for our Core Web Experience and help raise its quality across the teams that contribute to it.

This is a hands-on, AI-first individual-contributor role. You will lead complex cross-team design work, bring a strong point of view, and support other designers with feedback, frameworks, and shared patterns.

You will partner with Stakeholders, Product Managers, and Engineers to connect customer needs, business goals, and technical realities, align teams, and carry ideas through to high-quality outcomes.

**What You Will Do

**

• Lead the end-to-end design of complex Core Web initiatives involving multiple teams, owning outcomes from problem framing through implementation.

• Work hands-on across problem framing, research, interaction design, prototyping, visual design, validation, and implementation.

• Use AI throughout the design process to expand exploration, accelerate learning, and make ideas tangible faster.

• Partner with stakeholders across teams to bring customer insight, data, business goals, and technical trade-offs into decisions and alignment.

• Identify gaps in customer journeys and shared web patterns, then work with the relevant teams to make practical improvements.

• Create frameworks, prototypes, and reusable guidance, and provide constructive feedback that helps other designers and teams deliver high-quality work.

**What You Could Bring

**

• 10+ years of experience in product design with a strong track record of designing and shipping sophisticated web products and leading complex work involving multiple teams.

• Deep expertise in responsive design, interaction patterns, information architecture, accessibility, and visual craft.

• Demonstrated experience using AI tools in real design work, with the curiosity to continually explore new capabilities and practices.

• Strong product judgment, connecting customer needs, business goals, data, and technical constraints while navigating ambiguity.

• A systems mindset, including experience evolving design systems, shared patterns, and fragmented experiences.

• Strong communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence decisions and help peers improve their work.

We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

outcomes.

jobs.description:
Are you a customer-facing project manager who thrives on paving the way to success for B2B customers? Do you speak fluent German and English – and perhaps Spanish/Italian? Do you see yourself in a fast-growing start-up with an international team that is securing critical electrical infrastructure?

Then you could be Oktogrid’s new Customer Success Manager!

About Oktogrid

Oktogrid helps secure critical infrastructure by bringing power transformers online for higher reliability and a more sustainable operation. Oktogrid’s sensor solution significantly accelerates the path to getting access to the right data to support operators with the necessary insights for their decision-making.

Founded in 2020. Oktogrid has the continued backing of major European investors, including ABB Electrification and Elewit Ventures, and works with a wide range of grid operators across Europe. The company has 14 employees, most of whom are based at the Copenhagen office, with sales colleagues based in Germany and the Netherlands. Oktogrid also works with an international development team. English is the company language.

About the role

Reporting directly to the CEO, who also heads up sales, you will ensure that Oktogrid’s customers get off to a strong start and support them on their journey as they continue to benefit of the value from the solution. As the Customer Success Manager, you will follow each new customer closely throughout the first 3-9 months – from installation workshops to confidently onboarding onto the Transformer Intelligence Platform.

You will remain their trusted point of contact for the entire customer journey, while your experience in project coordination will ensure that the right expertise from your colleagues is involved whenever needed. Your job is not to acquire new customers, but to build strong relationships with existing ones, identify new needs and plant the seeds for further collaboration. You will be based at the Copenhagen office, with occasional travel.

Your primary responsibilities:

• 
Running a structured onboarding process for new customers – from project kick-off workshops to onboarding onto the Transformer Intelligence Platform

• 
Following up closely with customers and holding regular check-ins to ensure that they get the value they expect

• 
Owning a portfolio of Danish and international customers, with a focus on German-speaking markets

• 
Engaging with a rich map of stakeholders within each customer organisation – for example, the operations managers in each region – so that the solution becomes part of their day-to-day work

• 
Bringing in Oktogrid’s technical experts when customers need in-depth answers about transformers, deeper data analytics or software integrations

• 
Identifying new needs and opportunities – such as additional analytics modules and reports – and passing them on to the product and operations teams

• 
Capturing customer feedback and success stories for Product and Marketing

• 
Building and continuously improving Oktogrid’s Customer Success process and playbook

About you

A background in utilities or within energy is a plus, but not a requirement – Oktogrid’s experts are at hand when in-depth expertise is needed. What matters most is that you are excellent at building trust, maintaining close dialogue with customers and picking up on when to involve your extended team at Oktogrid. Having previously worked within energy, telecoms, IT, SaaS or other B2B industries in which you have delivered complex solutions to large customers are relevant fields of experience. We envisage that you have:

• 
5-10 years’ experience in Customer Success or related customer-facing roles with B2B customers

• 
Experience of working with structured customer processes – ideally gained in a medium-sized company where you have had broad responsibility

• 
Experience in delivering complex solutions and managing long-term customer relationships, rather than having ambitions of driving transactional sales

• 
Technical understanding and the ability to explain complex solutions clearly to expert as well as non-expert stakeholders

• 
A proactive approach – you bring your own ideas to the table and take ownership of improving the way things are done

• 
Genuine curiosity about customers’ needs – you spot opportunities that create further value for them

• 
The drive to succeed in a fast-growing start-up as part of a high-performing, international team – and a preference for working from the office in close contact with customers and colleagues

• 
Fluent in German and English, written and spoken. Spanish and Italian would be a strong advantage, as many customers prefer to communicate in their own language

• 
Experience with utilities and an understanding of asset management practices would be an advantage, but is not a requirement

• 
A valid permit to live and work in Denmark (EU/EEA citizenship or a Danish work permit)

Oktogrid offers

• 
A key role with real influence in a company actively driving a meaningful climate impact

• 
Office-based work with flexible working hours, the option of working from home one day a week and a partly paid company lunch scheme every day

• 
A modern office space in Copenhagen at the border between Vesterbro and Frederiksberg, located close to green areas and a vibrant hub where innovation meets great city culture

• 
A salary based on qualifications, and a company-wide bonus scheme
